name: Library Customer
query:
SELECT
    `tabCustomer`.`customer_name` as `Customer Name:Link/Customer:150`,
    `tabCustomer`.`employee_id` as `Employee Id:Link/Employee:115`,
    `tabCustomer`.`customer_group` as `Customer Group:Data:130`,
    `tabCustomer`.`total_books` as `Total Books:Int:100`,
    `tabCustomer`.`is_member` as `Is Member:Check:100`,
    `tabCustomer`.`gender` as `Gender:Data:100`,
    `tabCustomer`.`mobile_no` as `Mobile No:Int:120`,
    `tabCustomer`.`email_id` as `Email Id:Data:190`
    FROM    
        `tabCustomer`
